author: Mark Atwood
text: Deferring out of the JMAP-ayoz review-loop frontier. The bead itself notes: 'If the sibling canonical (jmap-mail-server) also re-exports ClosureHandler, this fix needs to be a canonical-template propagation'. Verified: all 8 extension-server siblings carry the re-export (mail, chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata). Workspace-wide canonical-template change — needs its own epic, not inline in this single-crate review loop.
